name: Micron Technology
summary: Micron Technology is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 4: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill.

parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill

mentions.excerpt: Nvidia sat within 3 percent of a record at $5.6 trillion, while Micron traded above $1,000 a share.
That is the market’s split in one glance: Nvidia and Micron have been paid for scarcity; Alphabet, Meta and Oracle have been charged for financing.

sides.claim: Kris argues that the widespread professional view of an AI/chip bubble is wrong, because infrastructure companies have multi-year supply contracts and chipmakers like Micron and Nvidia cannot currently produce enough chips to satisfy demand.
